message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal offense(s) based on facts. Facts: Defendant operated hot pot restaurants, sold large amount of expired lamb meat. This is sale of unsafe food, violating Food Safety Law. Offense: 生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品 (selling food that is past its shelf life). In Chinese criminal law, the offense is "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品罪". According to correction rule: when listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa>, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Also maybe "非法经营罪"? But main is food safety. The facts: selling expired meat, which is unsafe. So offense: 生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品. No other conduct described. So single offense.

Thus JSON with reasoning and final answer.
